messages:
laura: Heads-up: launching "Twilight" pricing A/B experiment tomorrow 08:00 PT. A is new tiered sheet, B is legacy pricing with small attrition discount. Need finance + billing ops to confirm invoice rendering for both arms and that grandfather rules apply to existing annual contracts. cc @emma for legal/accounting sign-off. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pricing/twilight

javier: On it. Quick question  do we treat prepaid credits as grandfathered? Some older customers have prepaid credits which used old per-token rates.

tom: Prepaid credits should not be re-priced. Add credit-handling flag to invoice_payload.credit_preserved = true. I can patch billing engine to honor that for the B arm.

anita: Filed PR to add credit_preserved + pricing_label fields: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/1267. Deployed to staging for preview.

laura: Thanks. Also legal flagged one contract that references "per-token rate not to exceed X"  @emma can you review whether that needs a clause before we expose new tiers to that account in the A arm?

emma: Will review today. If contract protects old cap, we must route that account to B (legacy) regardless of cohort assignment. I'll add a rule to the routing table and share list by EOD.

javier: Running a quick cohort pull for A/B assignment sanity check:
```sql
SELECT acct_id, assigned_arm, monthly_spend, has_prepaid_credits
FROM experiments.pricing_twilight_subjects
WHERE snapshot_ts = '2026-04-08'
LIMIT 100;
```

accounting-bot: Pricing experiment task created  id=task-ptw-20260408 Owners=[laura,javier,anita] status=running

tom: Staging invoice previews for sample acct 112: 
- arm A (new tiers): https://staging.billing/previews/112A
- arm B (legacy): https://staging.billing/previews/112B

laura: Sample previews look good visually but notes: 1) arm A shows "Estimated next-month tier" which confuses support; change copy to "Projected tier based on current usage". 2) ensure "grandfathered" badge shows for preserved subs.

anita: Updated template copy and added badge. Pushed to staging. PR link updated.

javier: Ran reconciliation on staging run: totals match for sample batch, but vendor-tax-bot flagged that Avalara will return tax jurisdiction "CA-OR" unmapped for ~2% of addresses. See logs: https://logs.redwood/twilight/tax-errors

vendor-tax-bot: Alert from tax vendor "unmapped_jurisdiction" count=28 service=avalara job=tax-lookup-20260408. Suggest mapping fallback to default_state_tax=0.075 until vendor patch.

emma: Legal prefers we don't silently default taxes. If fallback applied, we must add invoice note: "Tax estimate applied due to vendor lookup issue; final tax subject to adjustment." Also need to notify affected customers.

laura: Agreed. Anita, can you add invoice note + send templated email for affected cohort? Use marketing-approved wording.

anita: Will do. Draft email: "We applied an estimated tax on your recent invoice due to a temporary vendor mapping issue. If adjusted, you'll see a correction on your next invoice." Will share for review in #finance-drafts.

javier: Also discovered rounding difference between legacy generator and new tier calc that shows a $0.01 delta on ~0.7% of invoices. Probably due to per-line rounding order. Proposing unified internal calc to 4-decimal then round at presentation.

tom: I can update the generator to use 4-decimal intermediate math. Minimal risk and will reduce diffs. Schedule deploy to staging after PR passes.

laura: Good. Decision matrix: - Hold any account with contract caps or prepaid credits on B arm. - Apply grandfathering badge + invoice_metadata.grandfathered=true for preserved subs. - Use tax-estimate footer when vendor returns unmapped jurisdiction. - Fix rounding to 4-decimal internal calc.

emma: Approved matrix, legal ok with email wording. Accounting signs off pending final nil-diff on EOD staging run.

anita: Merged PR, deploying to staging now. CI shows invoice template tests passing.

accounting-bot: Staging run complete  invoices_generated=120 errors=1 failures=[tax-unmapped] run_id=staging-ptw-20260408

javier: Re-ran after applying tax fallback note; invoices match except 1 customer with contract cap mismatch (should be B). I'll patch routing table and re-run.

laura: Please re-run and post final recon. If green, we flip to 10% canary tomorrow 08:00 PT and monitor for 24h. Metrics to watch: invoice_error_rate > 0.5%, revenue_delta_by_arm > 1.5%, customer_support_tickets > 3 per 1k canary users.

emma: I'll post contract-exempt list in this thread when complete.

anita: Done deploy. Preview links updated in PR comments.

laura: Thanks everyone. Action items recap: 1) emma publish contract-exempt list, 2) tom deploy rounding fix to staging and run recon, 3) javier verify tax fallback applied and re-run cohort, 4) anita push email template and invoice note. If all green by 07:00 PT tomorrow we promote to 10% canary. :rocket:
